# A program declares at least one window, and internal/build.Emit is where
# that is asked -- not the checker: `component c { … }` on its own is a
# perfectly good thing to type-check, and it is only as something to *run* that
# it has nowhere to draw.

sngl check nowindow.sngl
stdout 'nowindow.sngl: ok'

! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out nowindow.sngl
stderr 'a program declares at least one window'
! exists out/index.html

# A library package the command line names is exempt: generating one is a
# request for its declarations, and a library has no window by construction.
sngl generate --lang go --platform gtk4 -o libout sngl:platform/gtk4
exists libout/model.go

# The same file with a window builds.
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=ok window.sngl
exists ok/index.html

-- nowindow.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component card ui {
    text(value="hi")
}
-- window.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:app"

component card ui {
    text(value="hi")
}

window {
    card
}
